name: chip
title: Chip
description: Compact pills for tags, contacts and filters, with an optional avatar image and close button.
improvements: The close button is a real button with an accessible name ("Remove <label>"), not a clickable icon font glyph.
Image URLs are plain props with unsafe schemes dropped, never concatenated into HTML.
Selected and keyboard-focus states use the secondary color; dark mode via tokens.
asChild turns any element (button with aria-pressed, link) into a chip for filter or choice chips.
